name: Policy Page Template
summary: Passive self-contained policy document with required title and semantic body, optional independent update metadata, optional named canonical in-page navigation, intrinsic containment, and zero neutral runtime.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Contextual labelled article containing one complete policy document; standalone targets host it inside their document main.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Policy title and optional update metadata region.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Non-empty visible contextual heading with a target-unique id naming the article.

anatomy.name: date
anatomy.description: Optional target-formatted visible update metadata; becomes time[datetime] only when an exact machine value is independently supplied.

anatomy.name: toc
anatomy.description: Optional navigation region named by its visible table-of-contents title.

anatomy.name: tocTitle
anatomy.description: Conditionally required non-empty visible heading naming a supplied table of contents.

anatomy.name: tocList
anatomy.description: Native ordered list preserving policy-section order.

anatomy.name: tocLink
anatomy.description: Canonical Link anchor whose fragment resolves to one unique body section.

anatomy.name: body
anatomy.description: Required non-empty target-owned semantic legal document body.

anatomy.name: section
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned native thematic section with a stable id when referenced by the table of contents.

anatomy.name: sectionTitle
anatomy.description: Contextual body heading whose target-owned rank follows the host document hierarchy.

anatomy.name: overflow
anatomy.description: Optional named keyboard-scrollable wrapper used only for genuinely two-dimensional content that cannot reflow.

variants.name: default
variants.description: One complete legal-document presentation; policy type, source, layout measures and target capabilities are not variants.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One readable semantic type scale whose contextual heading tags remain target-owned.

states.name: bodyLinkHover
states.description: Contextual native-link hover when target-authored body markup cannot attach canonical Link classes.

states.name: bodyLinkFocusVisible
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on an unclassed target-authored body link.

states.name: overflowFocusVisible
states.description: Visible focus on an explicitly named keyboard-scrollable wide-content region.

behavior.name: requiredDocument
behavior.description: A non-empty title and non-empty semantic body are both required. Missing either omits the complete article rather than leaving an empty or incorrectly named shell.

behavior.name: updateMetadata
behavior.description: Visible target-formatted update text is independent from an optional exact machine-readable datetime. Targets never parse localized display text; a machine value alone renders nothing.

behavior.name: tableOfContents
behavior.description: A supplied table of contents requires a non-empty visible title, native ordered list and canonical Links. Each fragment resolves to one unique body section in matching order; generation, synchronization and active tracking remain target-owned.

behavior.name: semanticContent
behavior.description: Targets preserve authored paragraphs, contextual headings, lists, emphasis, quotations, figures, links, tables, code, dates and media. Wide two-dimensional content uses an explicitly named keyboard-scrollable wrapper without flattening the surrounding prose.

behavior.name: contentOwnership
behavior.description: The target owns legal content, accuracy, trust, sanitization, parsing, revisions, effective dates, localization, policy inventory, section identifiers, external-link policy, media and publishing.

behavior.name: passiveRuntime
behavior.description: P3 owns no controlled or uncontrolled state, event handler, observer, request, timer, parser, formatter, sanitizer, generated id, active-section tracker, focus relocation, authored motion, asset or neutral JavaScript.

properties.name: title
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the complete component when the title is empty.
properties.description: Non-empty visible policy-document title; targets choose its contextual heading rank and unique id.

properties.name: updatedDate
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit update metadata and ignore updatedDateTime.
properties.description: Optional target-formatted visible update metadata; it is never parsed into a machine value.

properties.name: updatedDateTime
properties.unsetBehavior: Render updatedDate as ordinary text when visible update metadata exists; omit the datetime attribute.
properties.description: Optional exact machine-readable datetime used independently with visible updatedDate text.

properties.name: tocTitle
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the complete table of contents when tocItems is absent or this title is empty.
properties.description: Visible heading that conditionally names a supplied table of contents; its native rank remains target-owned.

properties.name: tocItems
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the complete table of contents and ignore tocTitle.
properties.description: Target-owned native ordered list of canonical Links synchronized with unique body-section identifiers.

properties.name: body
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the complete component when no non-empty semantic body is supplied.
properties.description: Required non-empty target-owned semantic policy document; content trust, markup and publishing remain target responsibilities.

accessibility: Require a non-empty visible title and non-empty semantic body; omit the complete article when either is missing.
Use one document main. Exhibit and Studio render a contextual labelled article; standalone targets host it inside their main and choose contextual heading ranks.
Supply visible update text and exact machine-readable datetime independently; never parse localized text or render a machine value without visible metadata.
Omit an incomplete table of contents. When supplied, use a visible name, native ordered list, canonical Links, matching descriptive labels and unique same-document targets in body order.
Preserve native paragraphs, logical headings, lists, emphasis, quotations, figures, links, tables, code, dates and media in authored order.
Keep prose and media contained through narrow widths, localization, RTL, 200 percent text, 400 percent zoom, forced colors and user styles.
Wrap genuinely two-dimensional content in a target-named keyboard-scrollable region; do not make passive prose or the article itself focusable.
Add no custom ARIA widget role, active-section announcement, focus relocation, smooth-scroll requirement, authored motion or neutral runtime.

web.notes: Contextual article, independent update metadata, optional named canonical Link navigation, semantic body flow, intrinsic containment and zero neutral runtime are implemented in canonical Pages CSS and target markup.

shopify.notes: A strict reusable snippet maps one supplied Liquid policy object's title/body to canonical P3 anatomy and truthfully omits date/index data absent from the platform object.
